topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the introductory framing and context for the lecture before the formal subject matter begins.

topics.label: Complement system overview, nomenclature, and the central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the general architecture, naming conventions, and central biochemical role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways and threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three recognition pathways that drive complement activation and converge on the trigger threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream processes by which activated complement eliminates pathogens and drives inflammation.

topics.label: Complement regulation and host cell protection
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the regulatory mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It explores the distinct clinical presentations and disease patterns associated with deficiencies in complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: It describes the molecular strategies and evolutionary mechanisms employed by pathogens to evade complement defenses.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: It closes the lecture and outlines the subject of the upcoming session.
